saw_lines: Chicken and beef get bought by the box, and buyers compare them against the grocery store before they click.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether the box is worth the shipping cost.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act. Open three new video ads with that line.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 11 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 22 ads mention it, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Open three new video ads with that 10% line and test them against the chicken story.

Your 22 fixed copy ads open with 10 different stories, and the biggest, the “most chicken never sees the” line, leads only 4. Repeat viewers never get one clear idea. Make six variations of that opener and drop the single-use stories.

Your homepage shows prices from $11.00 to $27.99, yet none of your 30 ads answers price, and 0 mention subscription. Shipping gets 5 ads, so the cost question stays open. Launch two subscription ads that send buyers to your bundle page.

3 ads have run 60+ days, so that copy works. Build fresh variations of those winners, each with a new opening line and the 10% first order offer, three versions per winner. Keep the frozen line in each.

ads_1: Offer-led video ads built on the chicken opener and the frozen delivery angle
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
